$description: RoleManager (platform/patterns/RoleManager), library wave 11, lane A: its pattern tokens. The gaps of the two views (the list under its bar; the detail’s header and sections), the detail’s title and section titles, the muted lines (Built-in or Custom, the description, the notes, the count), the permission groups’ grid and the Create role form. The rows are ResourceList’s, the roles RoleLabel’s, the permissions PermissionSummary’s and Checkbox’s.

role-manager-list-gap.$description: RoleManager: the list view: gap between the bar and the list (space-stack-md).

role-manager-section-gap.$description: RoleManager: the detail view: gap between the way back, the header and the sections (space-stack-xl).

role-manager-section-inner-gap.$description: RoleManager: gap inside a section, under its title (space-stack-md).

role-manager-meta-gap.$description: RoleManager: gap between a row’s member count and its kind, and a section title and its count (space-inline-sm).

role-manager-muted-text.$description: RoleManager: the muted lines: Built-in or Custom, the description, the notes, the count (content-muted).

role-manager-header-gap.$description: RoleManager: gap between the title, its RoleLabel and the actions (space-inline-md).

role-manager-header-row-gap.$description: RoleManager: gap between the header’s lines (space-stack-xs).

role-manager-title-line-height.$description: RoleManager: the role’s title line height (size-24px).

role-manager-focus-outline-color.$description: RoleManager: focus ring on the title when the detail opens by keyboard (focus-ring-color).

role-manager-actions-gap.$description: RoleManager: gap between Duplicate and Delete (space-inline-sm).

role-manager-text-font-size.$description: RoleManager: the description’s and notes’ size (font-size-13).

role-manager-text-line-height.$description: RoleManager: the description’s and notes’ line height (size-20px).

role-manager-section-title-line-height.$description: RoleManager: a section title’s line height (size-20px).

role-manager-count-font-weight.$description: RoleManager: the member count beside the section title (font-weight-regular).

role-manager-groups-gap.$description: RoleManager: gap between the permission groups (space-stack-lg).

role-manager-group-min-width.$description: RoleManager: a permission group’s least width before the groups wrap (size-240px).

role-manager-add-max-width.$description: RoleManager: Add a member: the picker’s greatest width (size-400px).

role-manager-form-gap.$description: RoleManager: Create role: gap between the fields (space-stack-md).
